card: Ballot and grade books copy every voter per vote: fold them in linear time
tests_added: packages/stage-kit/src/fold.perf.test.ts::folds a start_poll and 8000 distinct `!vote` lines in under 2 s
packages/stage-kit/src/fold.perf.test.ts::folds 8000 distinct `!grade` lines on one hex in under 1 s
packages/stage-kit/src/scene.test.ts::ballot and grade books > persistence: a retained scene's bars and grades never change when later ballots fold over it
packages/stage-kit/src/scene.test.ts::ballot and grade books > a re-vote after many other ballots moves the voter's weight rather than doubling it
packages/stage-kit/src/scene.test.ts::ballot and grade books > equivalence: the demo transcript and a seeded show fold to the views the Record books produced

packages/stage-kit/src/viewerBook.test.ts::ViewerBook (4 unit tests: overwrite/size across merges, latest value after merge, persistence incl. branching from an old book, 100k writes depth <= log2(n/32)+2)
guard_cases: equivalence: every intermediate pollBars/observedTally/gradeTallies of apps/stage/fixtures/demo.jsonl and a seeded 1,100-event show, FNV-hashed per event plus the final views deep-equal, snapshot captured at 829eb0a from the Record books (case 6)
deviations_from_card: (1) ChatMemory not rebuilt on ViewerBook: its old generation is bounded by CHAT_MEMORY_MAX and evicts with a keep-pinned rule, so its two-generation scheme is already linear; an unbounded book needs geometric merge levels (binary-counter LSM, O(log n) copies per entry), which ViewerBook implements. chatMemory.ts untouched. (2) ballots.ts (slot A's module, where castBallot/observedTally now live) is a coupled file outside the write set: castBallot keeps a per-option observedVoters count and writes the book; observedTally reads the count. (3) apps/console/budgets/bundle.json onair.l2 js 104,000 -> 105,000 (103,719 -> 104,613 B, measured by building HEAD without the change), sentence appended to $comment; ViewerBook trimmed to get/has/set/size/depth to keep it to +894 B. (4) Timing thresholds kept as the card's 2 s / 1 s but each fold bails at its budget, and the ratio uses best-of-3 with a 10 ms floor on the 2000-ballot fold.
notes: Before re-measured at 829eb0a (n=1/size): !vote 1k/2k/4k/8k = 47/409/2187/10084 ms; !grade 35/515/2496/9444 ms (8000/2000 vote ratio 24.6). After: !vote 11/18/38/53 ms (16k: 165), !grade 6/16/30/54 ms; perf cases run in ~110/73/258 ms against 2000/1000 ms bounds. Slot A's ballot-vector tests stay green (stage-kit 201/201). The observed float arithmetic is unchanged so views are bit-identical. First console test run had one red in src/pages/brain/layer2.test.tsx (5 s timeout, sibling console-brain-page work); re-run green 547/547. packages/stage-kit/nul is pre-existing litter, not mine.
